notes.title: Next Fest and Update 0.1.0
notes.notes:
Ensigns,

wanted to say Thank You for all the Feedback, Suggestions and shared Stories! Update 0.1.0 now offers an alternative to the horror-themed first away mission.
There were several patches during the Next Fest to address the reported issues. I'd be glad to put you into the full game's credits -> leave me a message with the wished name.

Thank You!

notes.title: Prologue Demo Release
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Next Fest starts soon and the Demo is ready to download, any feedback is welcome and appreciated! Hopefully the game's physics stays stable. Please share any strange things going on.
Just in case please remember: In space anything can happen!

Have Fun!
